text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, after our meeting.
I decided to offer her some treats we received
from a clan relative the other day while
she took a break.
choice_data_list: It's a gift of rice crackers and b...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Yes, thank you.
choice_data_list: If I may be so bold, I shall parta...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I see. Please, make yourself comfortable.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Yet, how rare.
For an offer like that to come from you.
choice_data_list: I'm so sorry, how brazen of me...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
No, on the contrary, I would welcome it.
As much as you'd like...———

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(There are an awful lot of spicy dishes on
his plate...)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(There are an awful lot of spicy dishes on
her plate...)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ――Heh. Such exquisite attention to detail.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(Was that not long after we had first
entered into our contract, I wonder—)

text_block_list.name: Store Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Today's primo piatto—
Arrabbiata.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
choice_data_list: Excuse me, could I get a refill on...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
("I would like a coconut milk"—
Having placed that order, the Trainer
casually asked if I might care for one as
well.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(I recall quite vividly how
utterly astonished I was by that conduct.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (However, after the meal, you————)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—Do not look so disheartened, Trainer.
The fault lies with me for keeping it from
you.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...You said you can't handle spicy food?
choice_data_list: No, but... even up until now—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(He felt terribly remorseful that among the
meals he arranged for me every day,
a few had been seasoned too spicy.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(She felt terribly remorseful that among
the meals she arranged for me every day,
a few had been seasoned too spicy.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (Unable to bear the sight, I————)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Truly,
there is no need to trouble yourself over
it. By nature,
my position does not permit me to show likes
or dislikes.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why I trained so
fiercely.
Ever since childhood—

text_block_list.name: Young Rose
text_block_list.text: “Uuu... my mouth is burning...”

text_block_list.name: Personal Chef
text_block_list.text:
“You have already managed half of the
dish,
perhaps we should call it a day here...?”

text_block_list.name: Young Rose
text_block_list.text:
“No...
not yet! I shall finish every last bite!
Chef, bring me milk...!”

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
And so, I believed I had overcome it...
or so I had thought.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
To be noticed so easily by you...
I still have much to learn.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I apologize,
but could you keep this matter strictly
confidential?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(He has faithfully kept his promise
to keep it 'strictly confidential.'
But...)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(She has faithfully kept her promise
to keep it 'strictly confidential.'
But...)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(Ever since that day, the meals he
arranges for me have always been...)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(Ever since that day, the meals she
arranges for me have always been...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Savoring my share of the rice crackers,
I happened to glance up—
only to find Rose Kingdom
seemingly lost in thought.
choice_data_list: (What could be the matter, I wonde...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to fret so deeply on my
account,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I told you, I have overcome it.
It is not as if I cannot eat it.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
If this refreshment was offered to me,
it is only proper etiquette that I partake
of it fully.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From her expression and gaze...
I realized she was calling me
out for hoarding all the spicy rice crackers
onto my own plate.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the same time...
it was pointed out that I have consistently
eliminated spicy foods from her meals outside
of official occasions. But...
choice_data_list: I was allowed to choose the flavor...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: You are... perhaps a bit too loyal.
choice_data_list: No, it is presumptuous of me.
It pales in comparison to your har...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
――Heh.
Is that so...?
Then I must offer you my thanks.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
“Having acquired an 'impudent retainer,'
I have, by mere chance,
found my days rather pleasant.”

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Nothing could be more fortunate...
Wouldn't you agree?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since childhood,
she has strived incessantly to conduct
herself
in a manner befitting one who bears the Rose
Clan;
I am always desperate to keep pace with her
earnest devotion.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It is hardly something worthy of being called
effort.
If anything,
I cannot help but feel I am indulging in
your kindness and growing lax...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I have heard that spicy food is,
to some extent,
a matter of 'getting used to it'...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I think I shall partake in the mildly
spicy rice crackers after all.
Trainer, would you mind?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once more, it was a moment that left me
in awe of her relentless work ethic.
